newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African Board says sold 45,000 t maize. [CORRECTED 11:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: South African Board says sold 45,000 t maize. [CORRECTED 11:40 GMT]

text.p: South Africa's Maize Board said on Thursday it had sold 45,000 tonnes of white maize for domestic and export use (corrects results of tender).
The board said it had sold 25,000 tonnes of maize to Andre Genfood at $155.55 per tonne Free Alongside Elevator (FAE) and 5,000 tonnes of maize to Louis Dreyfus at $155.35 per tonne FAE.
It also sold 15,000 tonnes of maize domestically to Premier Milling at 775.66 rand per tonne.
The tender, which closed on November 12, was for 75,000 tonnes of white maize for domestic use or export during December.
